notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/]Union of Gnomes: Prologue[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Crazy Soccer release
notes.content:
The Interstellar Soccer Cup is here! 
It's time to create your own soccer team and play against aliens! Or against Spartans! Or against... cows? Sounds crazy, and it plays even crazier than that: use mines, teleports, or any other dirty trick to win! Play with your friends, go to other planets and become an Interstellar Champion! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/735550/Crazy_Soccer/

Multiply madness with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7608][b]Crazy Soccer Bundle[/b] [/url]! 
You get two titles with 20% off: 
- FootLol - a game which has already gathered tens of thousands of positive reviews.
- CrazySoccer - a remastered, enhanced and 'whatever other adjective you can come up with' version of the game.

And remember that having one of those games in your Steam library makes buying the other one cheaper thanks to this bundle. It's hard to imagine a better way to add some craziness into your life. Also, aliens. Just saying.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32882384/c5110d38c49250731bb503aee1bed4bc241ebc6a.gif[/img]
